prompt: Write R code to compute row-wise median expression and related dispersion metrics using genefilter and matrixStats helper functions. You are working with a gene expression count matrix stored as a tab-separated file at inputs/counts.tsv, where rows are genes and columns are samples. Load both genefilter and matrixStats with library(genefilter); library(matrixStats). Use matrixStats::rowMedians to compute the median expression per gene, genefilter::rowIQRs for the IQR, and matrixStats::rowMads (or an equivalent MAD implementation) for dispersion. For each gene, calculate these three metrics and organize them into a data frame with columns: gene, median_expression, mad_expression, and iqr. Save this summary table to outputs/row_medians.csv. Rely only on genefilter and matrixStats (plus base R) rather than adding other toolkits. As a basic quality check, confirm that the output file is created, review a few rows to ensure the median, MAD, and IQR values are biologically reasonable, and check for any unexpected NA values.
